correctness.rationale: PASS: L/Z(L)=K³ has commutator cross-product coordinates, so two projected vectors commute iff K-collinear, including characteristic two. Distinct inverse images of the P=Q²+Q+1 K-projective points are precisely maximal Fq-abelian 3m-spaces, pairwise intersecting in 2m-center; Gaussian-binomial inclusion-exclusion gives A_d and P Q^{3r}−(P−1)Q^{2r}. Bracketing with KX,KY and then KX,KY again forces any ideal with X/Y-component to contain D, and a U-component to contain Z; hence the three disjoint ideal families giving I_d. D is characteristic singleton and GL2(K) plus U-shears transitively moves other maximal abelian spaces, yielding two orbits. Independent exact arithmetic for q=2,m=2 gives 21 maximal abelian, 137 ideals, 80896 commuting pairs and full dimension sequences, matching inspected verification source; arbitrary q,m rest on algebraic proof.
